description: “I am proud to endorse David Tucker for the Vermont House. Throughout his public service career, David has proven himself to be an independent, hard-working advocate who will deliver for our rural communities. The residents of Barnet, Ryegate, and Waterford need a representative who listens and follows through, and David is exactly the right person […]
